description.content: Search for property records in a geographical area, or by a specific address.

query.value: 5500 Grand Lake Dr, San Antonio, TX, 78244
query.description: The **full address** of the property, in the format `Street, City, State, Zip`. Used to retrieve data for a specific property, or together with the `radius` parameter to search for properties in a circular area
The name of the city, used to search for properties in a specific city. This parameter is case-sensitive
The 2-character state abbreviation, used to search for properties in a specific state. This parameter is case-sensitive
The 5-digit zip code, used to search for properties in a specific zip code
The latitude of the search area. Use the `latitude`/`longitude` and `radius` parameters to search for properties in a circular area
The longitude of the search area. Use the `latitude`/`longitude` and `radius` parameters to search for properties in a circular area
The radius of the search area in miles, with a maximum of 100. Use in combination with the `latitude`/`longitude` or `address` parameters to search for properties in a circular area

The type of the property, used to search for properties matching this criteria. See [explanation of property types](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/property-types). Supports [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The number of bedrooms, used to search for properties matching this criteria. Use `0` to indicate a studio layout. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The number of bathrooms, used to search for properties matching this criteria. Supports fractions to indicate partial bathrooms, [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The total living area size in square feet, used to search for properties matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The total lot size in square feet, used to search for properties matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The year of construction, used to search for properties matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The number of days since a property was last sold, with a minimum of 1. Used to search for properties that were sold within the specified date range. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters)
The maximum number of property records to return, between 1 and 500. Defaults to `50` if not provided. [Learn more](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/pagination) about pagination

The index of the first property record to return, used to paginate through large lists of results. Defaults to `0` if not provided. [Learn more](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/pagination) about pagination
When enabled, will return the total number of results matching the current query in the `X-Total-Count` response header. Defaults to `false` if not provided
